title: Classify length-6 support for five frames plus one old projector
body:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->

## Change and mathematical scope

Support classification for one equation, plus an integral character obstruction. No new κ and no word.

Fix one old projector `E` in `{A,B,P,Q}`. Five nonzero symmetric rational rank-one matrices sum to `4I-E` and meet all four targets as subset sums if and only if three of them are the complementary projectors and the other two are a rational rank-one splitting of `2I`. The integral splittings are exactly `{2A,2B}` and `{2P,2Q}`. Each integral solution detects two calls and four targets under the inherited `P`-coefficient character, so it is not a word. One pairwise nonparallel splitting, at chart parameter `t=2`, is a support witness only.

The selected record stays κ = `781451/250000000`. This package does not change the selected frontier and does not lower the eight-call minimum.

Evidence classes, kept apart:

1. **Construction proof.** For each projector `E`, the three complementary projectors plus any rank-one splitting of `2I` meet support. The identity `Q(2I-X)-Q(X)=4(2-tr X)` classifies those splittings. Integral points are read off the discriminant `4-c^2`.
2. **Exhaustive finite census, hence the converse.** Subset sizes 2, 3, and 4 give 230300 unordered 4-tuples. Twins: 22370. Rank 3: 2450, all inconsistent. Full-support kernels: 3840, all killed by the trace test `2,3,4 ≠ 7`. One frozen frame: 27840, none on the cone. Three frozen frames: 53400, of which 240 are consistent and on the cone, in bijection with placements of the three complementary projectors. Invertible: 120400, zero cone hits.
3. **Explicit witnesses, not a word.** Integral witness `A,P,Q,2A,2B` with old call `B`. Nonparallel `t=2` frames `(-2/5,4/5,8/5)` and `(12/5,6/5,-8/5)`.

## Task and overlap

Base commit: `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840` (upstream CrocSwap `main`, “Checkpoint completed November 10 queue review and remaining obligations”).

Task card: `bit-new-register-model`, priority revision 8. **Scope changed.** The card asks for a larger or nonabelian native alphabet. This package stays in the abelian symmetric 2-by-2 model and answers open question 2 of unpaidmoon PR #7024 (discussion comment 19514165): can five added signed rank-one frames plus one old call meet support at length 6? First step was the equation `R+S+T+U+V=4I-E`.

Concrete object: one fixed projector plus five free rank-one frames. Domain: the 230300 unordered 4-tuples of subset masks of sizes 2, 3, and 4, for each of the four projectors and each target assignment.

Not redone: the five-call `4I` theorem of #7024, the four-call theorem of merged #6952, six frames with no old call, and four frames plus old calls. A second old call is not added. No open upstream PR states this equation. Discussion #2091 fixes one fifth address in a different alphabet and is not contradicted, because no word is exhibited.

## Validation

Environment: Python 3.12. Registered replay:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/five-signed-one-old --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/five-signed-one-old
```

Both registered commands passed (`PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, outcome `completed`), including the `python -O` rerun. Direct check: `python3 -I -W error -B research/five-signed-one-old/verify.py` (about 90 seconds). Checks use `require`, so `-O` still executes them.

The census is an exhaustive finite classification, not a heuristic search. The splitting identity and the construction are proofs inside the inherited model. The determinant identity, subset-sum necessity, and character inequality are inherited from `research/bit-two-signed-frame-floor` and are not reproved. Predecessor replays, Lean, Docker, and the selected-result cold replay were not run.

Failure controls: `I`, zero, and `A+P` are not rank one; shifting the total by `A` stops recovery of the `t=2` witness. Positive control: the invertible solver recovers the `t=2` witness from its own subset sums.

## Credit

The register model is Cinna Davis's PR2085/2112 formal model. The determinant, subset-sum necessity, and character inequality are the PR2910 package as recorded in apoursh's two-signed-frame floor, PR6190. The three-frame all-old-once character is `research/three-signed-old-once`. The four-call support proof is `research/four-signed-once-parity`, merged as #6952. The five-call census and this open question are #7024, discussion comment 19514165. None of those theorems is redone.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. No independent human or formal-kernel review. New work is Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Can one rational splitting of `2I` make this length-6 support solution into a word? A word would lower the eight-call minimum. The integral pairs already fail the `P`-coefficient test. The smallest follow-up is the same count on the displayed `t=2` frames `(-2/5,4/5,8/5)` and `(12/5,6/5,-8/5)`, with old call `B` and frozen frames `A`, `P`, and `Q`. Passing that count would still not be a word: support is necessary, not sufficient. Six added frames with no old call, and four added frames plus an old call, are different equations.
